S767 (owner moved the guest pages onto the default Modernist preset): the ONLY radius left in this directory is 50% on the veg / non-veg food mark dot (.gm-diet in guestMenu.css) - the market food-labelling symbol, named as a Shapes exemption in DESIGN.md. Replaces the pre-S767 entries that exempted the whole bone-and-pine guest shape language.
